notes: LUNGING. Intro: the bud swells, the yellow cowlick bursts open, then it shivers; the claws, stem and bracts hold. Two-hue case: the green is index 1 (shaded with black, lit with white rims) and the yellow index 2, breaking through the bracts' seams. Sport: pink dandelion. Taraxacum pseudoroseum, the pink dandelion of Central Asia: rose florets with pale tips (indexes 1-2 only).
